svg.title: Blue Curve III
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Wide diamond-shaped support. White top triangle belongs to painting; curved blue-white division retained. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://collections.lacma.org/object/33211; source object M.73.76; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
